name: psychology
description: Connect Psychology to distil the memories and past chats you choose, surface candidate patterns and likely answers, and ask only about consequential gaps. Also supports non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection.

interface.shortDescription: Distil the memories and past chats you choose; explore patterns and likely answers, then fill only real gaps.
interface.longDescription: Start with the memories, past chats, or selected conversations the current assistant can actually access. Psychology helps distil relevant strengths, patterns, preferences, and likely answers for your goal, show the examples behind candidate insights, and ask only about gaps that could change what comes next. The assistant must say when a requested source is unavailable. For a named self-report item, it may suggest a source-linked, uncertain candidate from selected context, but that answer stays pending until you confirm or edit it; you can also reject or skip it. Objective performance items remain yours to answer. Psychology also supports non-clinical reflection with published or clearly labelled instruments. It is not therapy, diagnosis, or treatment. The hosted connector uses OAuth authorization-code flow with mandatory S256 PKCE; do not paste a static token or credential. A host is supported only after its exact version has a recorded acceptance result. Signed-in storage reads require applicable consent and an explicit per-session source choice; stored results, profiles, and journal content are never loaded by default.
defaultPrompt: Use the memories and past chats you can access to distil strengths and likely answers for my goal, grounded in examples. Before drafting, call psychology_get_profile_distillation_guide once; if the tool is unavailable or the call fails, say so plainly and continue with accessible context. For this draft, do not call other Noesis tools or claim permission/data checks. Ask only consequential gaps.
I will paste selected conversations or a memory summary. Distil the context relevant to my goal, show candidate patterns with examples, and ask only what remains unclear.
Check whether the Psychology MCP is connected. If not, guide me through secure setup first; never ask me to paste a password, token, or credential.
